local_helper_pins: all three unchanged imported helpers pinned in protocol and launcher

controls.selection: six exact pytest node names frozen in launcher

tree_cpu_accounting: outer GNU time captures waited launcher/control/native descendants; child timing is descriptive and not added twice
outer_recipe: cd exact root; reject existing launched or tree/stdout/stderr paths; verify frozen bundle hashes; ulimit -t 60 and -v 4194304; /usr/bin/time -v -o launch_tree.time.log timeout --signal=KILL 300s bash run_native_throughput.sh > launch.stdout.log 2> launch.stderr.log
termination_scope: outer default process group gets uncatchable KILL at 300s; inner timeouts use --foreground to retain that group; fixed Python payload/tests spawn no child processes; payload threads share the Python process
outer_timeout_cpu_accounting: if outer timeout kills before descendant wait/reaping, mark tree accounting incomplete, retain reservation and do not claim exact measured child CPU
launch_claim: exclusive mkdir launched before payload spawning; durable controls.claimed and real.claimed slot directories
